=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2606-2618, 2665-2675 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When a retry read in the `state_unavailable` branch of `rb_judge_merge_retry_transient` is unreadable, it always overwrites `SYNC_MERGE_BLOCKED_GUARD_STATE="blocked"` with "unreadable". In auto-only mode no later guard call restores "blocked", so a later non-transient `--auto` refusal makes `rb_judge_deferred_merge_pending` (lines 2669-2672) return 0.
  WHY: The run is classified `RB_MERGE_STATUS=mergeability_pending` instead of `merge_failed`, which suppresses the "Needs merge investigation" alert and lets stall recovery keep re-firing the judge on an unmergeable PR. This is a regression in the last run that breaks the #9939 contract. Four reviewers rated it MAJOR; minimax gave no severity.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2585-2600 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `rb_judge_merge_retry_transient` checks for a changed head (2587) before it checks whether the PR is closed (2596). A closed PR whose head also moved therefore exits with `RB_MERGE_RETRY_GIVEUP=head_moved` instead of `not_open`.
  WHY: The merge and terminal callers (2831-2842, 2966-2977) emit `AUTOFIX_MERGE_SKIPPED ... reason=pr_closed closed_at=<iso>` and release the lease only for `not_open`. On this path the run ends `merge_failed` with no skip line and the lease still held, which violates Goal 3. Reviewers disagree on severity: gpt said MAJOR, glm said NIT and minimax gave none. The highest, high, is used.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:3574-3589 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The `merge_with_followup` sync caller after `rb_judge_merge_retry_transient direct sync` has no `RB_MERGE_RETRY_GIVEUP=not_open` branch, so a closed PR falls through to the generic `else`.
  WHY: The `else` branch writes `judge_skip_reason=sync_merge_failed` and never calls `_pr_merge_state_check`, so no `AUTOFIX_MERGE_SKIPPED ... reason=pr_closed` line is logged and the merge lease is not released. Minimax gave no severity; high reflects the other reviewers' MAJOR rating of the same gap, which they filed as a task gap.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "On a closed PR the job ends with success, merges nothing, releases the lease if it holds it, and logs one line: `AUTOFIX_MERGE_SKIPPED pr=<n> head_sha=<sha> reason=pr_closed closed_at=<iso>`." (issue #10049 Goal 3)
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_rb_judge.sh, the `merge_with_followup` sync merge result handling after `rb_judge_merge_retry_transient direct sync` (lines 3574-3589). It needs an `RB_MERGE_RETRY_GIVEUP=not_open` branch that mirrors the merge site (2831-2842) and the terminal site (2966-2977).
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The retry helper returns 1 with GIVEUP=not_open and RB_MERGE_RETRY_CLOSED_AT set (2596-2600). The sync caller handles only three outcomes: success, `RB_SYNC_MERGE_DEFERRED=true` (3579), and a generic else that writes `judge_skip_reason=sync_merge_failed` (3584-3588). That else emits no AUTOFIX_MERGE_SKIPPED line and no closed_at, and makes no `_merge_lease_release_for_pr` call. closed_at handling was added only at the merge and terminal sites. The deferral test at tests/test_review_rb_judge_head_binding.py:902 is parametrized only over ("merge", "terminal"), so the sync path is never exercised. The outcome is misreported as "sync merge failed despite passing check-runs", which tests/test_alert_levels_human_only.py:668 treats as alert-worthy.
- requirement: "The same check runs when the job starts and when it takes or asks for the merge lease, so a closed PR does not take the lease, does not update its branch and does not wait on checks." (issue #10049 Goal 2)
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_merge_train.sh::_mt_final_ci_merge_resume, before the `_pr_base_fresh_for_merge` call
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: `_pr_base_fresh_for_merge` runs at lines 2769-2771, before `_pr_merge_state_check` at 2785-2787. The `continue` at 2771 on the overlap path skips the state read entirely. The comment at 2773-2784 accepts this as a one-call tradeoff. As a result, a PR that closes between the open-PR listing (2780) and the freshness gate can still be granted the lease and get a branch update. (anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash explicitly did not raise this item and treated it as an already-accepted residual.)
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2606-2618 (consumer 2669-2672) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `state_unavailable` branch of `rb_judge_merge_retry_transient` sets `SYNC_MERGE_BLOCKED_GUARD_STATE="unreadable"` / `SYNC_MERGE_BLOCKED_GUARD_BLOCKERS="unknown"` and overwrites "blocked". In auto-only mode nothing rewrites the state, because the `[ "${_rb_retry_auto_only}" != "true" ] || continue` at line 2622 skips rb_judge_sync_merge_guard.
  WHY: The sequence guard blocked → `--auto` transient → 5xx read → `--auto` non-transient → GIVEUP=non_transient makes rb_judge_deferred_merge_pending return 0. The result is mergeability_pending instead of merge_failed, which suppresses "Needs merge investigation" and lets stall recovery re-fire. This is a regression from the last run. Hardening fix: wrap the assignments at 2615-2616 in `if [ "${SYNC_MERGE_BLOCKED_GUARD_STATE:-}" != "blocked" ]` (about 3 lines).
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "On a closed PR the job ends with success, merges nothing, releases the lease if it holds it, and logs one line: `AUTOFIX_MERGE_SKIPPED pr=<n> head_sha=<sha> reason=pr_closed closed_at=<iso>`." | Expected change site: scripts/review_rb_judge.sh, `merge_with_followup` sync merge result handling after `rb_judge_merge_retry_transient direct sync` (lines 3574-3589); it needs a not_open branch like the ones at line 2831 and line 2966 | Evidence of absence: The helper returns 1 with GIVEUP=not_open and RB_MERGE_RETRY_CLOSED_AT set (2596-2600). The caller handles only success, `RB_SYNC_MERGE_DEFERRED=true` (3579) and a generic else that writes `judge_skip_reason=sync_merge_failed` (3588). There is no skip line, the lease taken by `_pr_base_fresh_for_merge` is not released, and the PR is misreported as a failed merge. Hardening fix: after 3583, add `elif [ "${RB_MERGE_RETRY_GIVEUP:-}" = "not_open" ]` with `_pr_merge_state_check ... pre_merge` and `judge_skip_reason=pr_not_open` (about 8 lines) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
- NOTE (not raised; treated as already-accepted residuals): the merge-train start check before `_pr_base_fresh_for_merge` (scripts/review_merge_train.sh lines 2769-2789), and the head_moved-before-not_open ordering (lines 2585-2600). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

  WHY: A later non-transient `--auto` failure misses the "blocked" check at line 2670, so the run becomes mergeability_pending instead of merge_failed. That suppresses the alert and breaks the #9939 invariant.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2587-2600 (callers 2831-2842, 2966-2977) | confidence=4

  WHY: Goal 3 is not met and Goal 1's state == open check is bypassed. The run is treated as a fresh-push failure and the lease stays held.
